scope: scope-correct count-based allocator/CPU/GPU/wait probes; frozen R full AOT, independent best-fit suffix; no production/default changes
decision: Direct allocation host-call cost is small here; investigate GPU/elapsed encoding without promoting defaults or claiming causality.
limitations: GPU intervals overlap. Their sum is not elapsed GPU time; union is reported execution coverage, not active cycles/utilization.
CPU wait overlaps GPU execution. Reclaim/eviction and Metal allocation scopes are nested in inclusive allocation; encoding is an elapsed envelope, not active CPU compute.
Explicit waitUntilCompleted covers that method only; implicit driver blocking and OS descheduling are not separately attributed.
Probe/off comparisons include timing/scheduling and trace I/O effects; no exact correction is subtracted.
Count-based10+40-frame runs differ from stage19 time-window benchmark; no cross-campaign splicing or acceptance.
Driver allocation CPU wall time does not account for deferred mapping/initialization elsewhere.
